//: Harry, as any Claude session reaches it: HTTP MCP on localhost, behind a bearer token. The same entry works for the probe today and for real Harry later, because both answer on HARRY_PORT at /mcp — which is the point of the port having exactly one owner. harry-remote is the same server reached from outside the house, through its own Cloudflare tunnel, for a Claude cloud routine that cannot see localhost. Its header has NO fallback on purpose: a routine that fails to present its own token must be refused, or the test that it can present one cannot fail. On this branch it reaches the probe, not Harry.
